categories.main_business_segments: Nissan Shatai primarily operates in the automotive sector, focusing on the manufacturing and sales of passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, small buses, and special-purpose vehicles. The company also has segments for automotive parts and bodies, equipment maintenance, information processing, and personnel dispatch services, mainly through its domestic subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages integrated manufacturing capabilities from development to production, with a focus on advanced vehicle assembly, special vehicle customization, and small-lot production techniques. Key technological initiatives include the adoption of advanced safety features (such as collision mitigation brakes and pedal misapplication prevention), full digital instrument clusters, and environmentally friendly production methods, including energy-saving equipment and EV conversion of company vehicles.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Nissan Shatai's primary customer is Nissan Motor Co., Ltd., which accounts for over 97% of its sales. The end markets are mainly commercial vehicle and premium car segments, with a significant portion of production exported to North America, Latin America, and the Middle East. The company also serves domestic Japanese customers, especially for special-purpose vehicles and commercial vans.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in Japan, with manufacturing facilities in Kanagawa, Kyoto, and Fukuoka prefectures. While all subsidiaries are domestic, a large share of finished vehicles is exported, with key overseas markets being North America, Latin America, and the Middle East.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nissan Shatai operates primarily as a downstream manufacturer, assembling finished vehicles and special-purpose vehicles, and supplying them to Nissan Motor and its global distribution network. It also provides automotive parts and bodies, and supports upstream and midstream activities through equipment maintenance and engineering services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening the sustainability of the business foundation, creating attractive and differentiated products, and deepening unique capabilities. R&D focuses on environmental technologies (carbon neutrality, energy efficiency), advanced safety and ITS features, and responding to CASE (Connected, Autonomous, Shared, Electric) trends. The company is also investing in digitalization, diversity, and supply chain resilience.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through the sale of manufactured vehicles and automotive parts to Nissan Motor Co., Ltd., under contract manufacturing and supply agreements. Additional revenue streams include equipment maintenance, information system services, and personnel dispatch, but these are minor compared to automotive manufacturing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Nissan Shatai is positioned as a key contract manufacturer within the Nissan Group, competing internally with other Nissan production sites and externally with global contract manufacturers. Its market position is highly dependent on Nissan Motor's production strategies, and it differentiates itself through its integrated manufacturing and special vehicle capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated net sales were 350.5 billion yen, with operating profit of 5.1 billion yen and net profit attributable to parent company shareholders of 3.0 billion yen. The company has shown a recovery in sales and profitability after previous declines, with a 16.4% year-on-year sales increase and a significant rebound in profits, reflecting new model launches and improved production volumes.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nissan Shatai emphasizes its ability to deliver high-quality, attractive vehicles and services in a timely manner, leveraging its integrated development-to-production system. Its unique strengths include expertise in commercial and premium vehicles, special-purpose vehicle customization, and responsiveness to customer and market needs, supported by advanced safety, environmental, and digital technologies.
